plugins.name: gc-ai
plugins.description: Work in your GC AI legal knowledge base from Claude: upload documents, run review playbooks, and ask questions grounded in your own files, all as you.

skills.name: ask
skills.description: Ask a legal question grounded in the user's GC AI knowledge base, optionally against specific documents. Use for legal research, summarization, or Q&A over the user's own files, playbooks, and skills rather than the model's general knowledge.
headings: Ask GC AI a grounded question
skills.description_zh: 依据用户 GC AI 知识库和指定文档回答法律问题，用于用户文件、操作手册与技能上的研究、摘要及问答。

skills.name: organize-matter
skills.description: Group documents into a GC AI project (matter) so later review and questions are scoped to it. Use when the user is starting a new matter, deal, or case, or wants a set of files kept and worked on together.
headings: Organize a matter in GC AI
skills.description_zh: 将文档组织为 GC AI 项目或法律事项，限定后续审查问答范围，适用于新案件、交易或共同处理的一组文件。

skills.name: review-document
skills.description: Review one or more documents against a GC AI playbook and summarize the findings. Use when the user wants a contract or document checked, redlined, or run through a review playbook in their GC AI knowledge base.
headings: Review a document with a GC AI playbook
skills.description_zh: 按 GC AI 知识库中的审查手册核对一份或多份合同文档、进行修订并总结发现。

name: gc ai
summary_zh: 提供使用 Claude 的 GC AI 法律知识库进行工作：上传文档、运行审阅手册以及根据您自己的文件提出问题。
